dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001229\_21](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001229) Tropical depression during the period Oct 18 2025-Oct 23 2025 in Viet Nam, China, Cambodia, Philippines, Laos, Thailand. The center of the storm was located near latitude 16.0 longitude 108.6. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
